name: opensearch-mcp-apps
description: Multi-app MCP server that talks directly to AWS OpenSearch domains (managed service) via SigV4. Exposes traces, logs, services, anomaly detection, agent observability, and more. Discovers domains at runtime via es:ListDomainNames; no OpenSearch UI / Dashboards application required.

region.title: AWS region
region.description: Region used by both es:ListDomainNames and SigV4 signing, e.g. us-west-2. Use the `list_domains` tool to discover OpenSearch domains in this region.

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: Profile name from ~/.aws/config used for SigV4. Leave blank to use the SDK default credential chain (env vars, instance role, etc.).

tools.name: traces_details
tools.description: Load all spans for a single OpenTelemetry trace and render them as a hierarchy with inline timeline bars and a span attribute panel. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `dataset` (the trace index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`, e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), and `traceId`; optionally override `limit` (default 500).

tools.name: traces_from-log
tools.description: Pivot from a log line to its full trace tree. Pass `dataSourceId`, `traceId` (extracted from the log row), and optionally `tracesDataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), `fromLogId`, `fromLogDataset` (surfaced in the header for context), and `limit` (default 500).

tools.name: traces_dag
tools.description: Render the spans of a single trace as a node-and-edge DAG (parent→child) using inline SVG. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `traceId`, and optionally `dataset` (defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 500).

tools.name: traces_gantt
tools.description: Render a Gantt-style timeline of all spans for a trace, sorted by start time. Each span is a horizontal bar coloured by service. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `traceId`, and optionally `dataset` (defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 500).

tools.name: traces_related-logs
tools.description: Load logs linked to a specific trace (and optionally span) by traceId/spanId. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `logsDataset` (logs index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`), and `traceId`. Optional `spanId` and `limit` (default 200).

tools.name: traces_cross-signal-join
tools.description: Join spans and logs by traceId (and spanId if present in logs) and render them as a unified chronological timeline. Pass `dataSourceId`, `logsDataset`, and `traceId`. Optional `spansDataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 500 per side).

tools.name: traces_conversation
tools.description: Group all spans for a GenAI conversation id (`attributes.gen_ai.conversation.id`) and render them as a chronological timeline grouped by traceId. Pass `dataSourceId` and `conversationId`. Optional `dataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 500).

tools.name: traces_tool-calls
tools.description: Inspect all GenAI tool-call spans in a single trace (spans where `attributes.gen_ai.tool.name` is set). Renders one card per tool call with name, call id, arguments, and result. Pass `dataSourceId` and `traceId`. Optional `dataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 500).

tools.name: traces_root-only
tools.description: List root spans (parentSpanId is empty), sorted by startTime descending. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`); optional `dataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 100).

tools.name: traces_metrics
tools.description: Aggregate KPIs across the trace list — Total traces, total input/output tokens, P50 / P99 root duration. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`); optional `dataset` (defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `serviceName`.

tools.name: traces_filter
tools.description: List trace root spans filtered by status / kind / service / gen_ai op. Pass `dataSourceId`; optional `dataset` (defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), `status` (`ok`|`error`), `kind` (`client`|`server`|`producer`|`consumer`|`internal`), `serviceName`, `genaiOp`. Sorted by `startTime` desc, capped at 200 rows.

tools.name: traces_queue-time
tools.description: For one trace, compute the gap between each parent span finishing and its child starting (= queue/wait time). Pass `dataSourceId` and `traceId`; optional `dataset` (defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`). Loads up to 500 spans and shows top-50 parent→child gaps by descending wait time.

tools.name: traces_sync-selection
tools.description: Static reference: documents the `traces:span-selected` CustomEvent bus contract used to keep span selection in sync across the Tree / DAG / Gantt views in the Traces app.

tools.name: traces_copy-id
tools.description: Static reference: how the trace UI exposes 'Copy trace ID' — the header chip clipboard target, the suggested `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C` keyboard shortcut, and the `/app/observability-traces#/?traceId=<id>` OSD deep-link pattern.

tools.name: traces_lazy-load
tools.description: Static reference: documents the OnDemandChildLoader pattern for lazy-loading child spans in a large trace tree.

tools.name: logs_explore
tools.description: Query an OpenSearch logs index with PPL and render a fielded log table with severity highlighting. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `dataset` (the logs index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`). Optionally supply `query` (the PPL chain after `source = <dataset>`, e.g. `where severity = "ERROR"`) and `limit` (default 200).

tools.name: logs_severity-filter
tools.description: Load the most recent logs filtered by severity. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `dataset` (logs index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`), and `severity` (`error`|`warn`|`info`|`debug`|`any`). Optional `limit` (default 200).

tools.name: logs_by-trace
tools.description: Load logs scoped to a specific OpenTelemetry traceId or spanId. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `dataset` (logs index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`), and at least one of `traceId` or `spanId`. Optional `limit` (default 200).

tools.name: logs_histogram
tools.description: Render a log volume histogram over time using PPL `span()` bucketing. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `dataset` (logs index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`). Optional `intervalMinutes` (default 5) and `severity` filter (`error`|`warn`|`info`|`debug`|`any`).

tools.name: logs_viz-switch
tools.description: Static reference of supported visualization types and which axes, legend, and threshold settings each one supports. Invoke when the user asks what viz types are available or which one to pick.

tools.name: logs_save-query
tools.description: Reference panel: how to persist a PPL log query as a `query` saved object. Documents the payload shape, the `/api/saved_objects/query` endpoint, and the OSD UI path. Includes a sample `errors-only-last-1h` payload.

tools.name: log-patterns_top
tools.description: Cluster log lines into the top recurring patterns using PPL `| patterns`. Required args: `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `dataset` (logs index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`, e.g. `logs-otel-v1-*`), and `patternsField` (the long log-body field, typically `body`, `message`, or `log`). Optional: `filter` (PPL chain inserted before `| patterns`, e.g. `where severity = "ERROR"`), `method` (`brain` (default) or `regex`), and `limit` (default 50).

tools.name: log-patterns_rare
tools.description: Surface the rarest recurring log patterns using PPL `| patterns` with ascending sort by count. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `dataset` (logs index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`), and `patternsField` (typically `body`, `message`, or `log`). Optional: `filter` (PPL chain inserted before `| patterns`), `method` (`brain` (default) or `regex`), and `limit` (default 30).

tools.name: log-patterns_change-detection
tools.description: Diff log patterns between an alert window and a baseline window. Runs `| patterns` twice and joins by pattern, computing delta = alert - baseline. Pass `dataSourceId`, `dataset`, `patternsField`, `alertStart`/`alertEnd`, and `baselineStart`/`baselineEnd` (all ISO 8601). Optional `method` and `limit` (default 200).

tools.name: services_catalog
tools.description: List services from a trace span index with RED-style KPIs (span count, error rate, avg/p50/p95/p99 latency). Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `dataset` (the span index pattern, e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*` — discover via `list_index_patterns`); optionally override `limit` (default 50).

tools.name: services_catalog-filter
tools.description: Service catalog filtered by environment / latency / throughput / failure-ratio / SDK language. Computes the same RED-style KPIs as `services_catalog`. Applies environment / SDK language filters in PPL `where`, then post-filters on `minP99Ms`, `minSpans`, and `maxErrorRate`. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `dataset` (the span index pattern, e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*` — discover via `list_index_patterns`); optional `environment`, `minP99Ms`, `minSpans`, `maxErrorRate`, `sdkLanguage`, and `limit` (default 100).

tools.name: services_kpi-cards
tools.description: Render the 5 service KPI cards (throughput, fault rate, error rate, availability, p99 latency) for one service from a trace span index. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (the span index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`).

tools.name: services_latency-deps
tools.description: Latency percentile (p50/p90/p99) for one service grouped by downstream dependency (`attributes.peer.service`, falling back to `attributes.net.peer.name`). Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (the span index pattern — discover via `list_index_patterns`, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `percentile` (`50` | `90` | `99`, default `99`).

tools.name: services_requests-by-op
tools.description: Top-K operations of a service by request count. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (the span index pattern — discover via `list_index_patterns`, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `topK` (`3` | `5` | `10`, default `5`).

tools.name: services_availability-ops
tools.description: Bottom-K operations of a service by availability (1 - error rate). Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (the span index pattern — discover via `list_index_patterns`, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `bottomK` (`3` | `5` | `10`, default `5`).

tools.name: services_operations
tools.description: Browse the operations of one service with per-operation request count, error count, error rate, avg/p50/p95/p99 latency. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (the span index pattern — discover via `list_index_patterns`, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), `filter` (`minLatencyMs`, `maxErrorRate`, `search`), and `limit` (default 100).

tools.name: services_dependencies
tools.description: Browse the downstream dependencies of one service. Group key is `coalesce(attributes.peer.service, attributes.net.peer.name, attributes.db.system, attributes.messaging.system)`. Returns per-dependency call count, error count, error rate, and latency percentiles. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (the span index pattern — discover via `list_index_patterns`, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 100).

tools.name: services_top-dep-paths
tools.description: Top-K (caller, callee) edges in the service map by fault rate (errorCount / requestCount). Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`); optional `dataset` (default `otel-v2-apm-service-map` — discover via `list_index_patterns`) and `limit` (default 20).

tools.name: services_correlation
tools.description: Correlate spans and logs for one operation. Runs two PPL queries: spans (`where serviceName=<svc> and name=<op>`) and logs (`where traceId in (<span trace ids>)`). Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `logsDataset`, `serviceName`, `operationName`; optional `spansDataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), `traceId`, and `limit`.

tools.name: services_compare-periods
tools.description: Compare a service's per-operation p99 latency across two time windows. Returns rows of `{op, w1_p99_ms, w2_p99_ms, deltaPct}` joined in JS by operation name. Pass `dataSourceId`, `serviceName`, `window1Start`/`window1End`, `window2Start`/`window2End`; optional `dataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`).

tools.name: services_status-codes
tools.description: Per-operation HTTP status code distribution (2xx / 3xx / 4xx / 5xx / other) for one service. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (the span index pattern — discover via `list_index_patterns`, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 100).

tools.name: services_alert-prefill
tools.description: Pre-fill the service detail with the alert's evidence: 5 service KPIs (throughput, fault rate, error rate, availability, p99 latency) plus the most recent error spans (statusCode = 2) in the alert window. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `alertId`, `since`, `until` (ISO 8601), and `dataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`).

tools.name: services_auto-refresh
tools.description: Static reference: the MCP renders read-only snapshots — to refresh a service detail panel, the chat host re-invokes the tool. Documents the recommended interval presets (10s, 30s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, off) and shows an example client-side `setInterval` snippet.

tools.name: alerts-dashboard_summary
tools.description: Aggregate alert volume by severity over a time range. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and optional `timeRange` (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d; default 24h). Reads from `.opensearch-alerting-alert-history-*` via PPL.

tools.name: alerts-dashboard_top-firing
tools.description: Find the noisiest OpenSearch alerting monitors by number of firings. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and optional `limit` (default 20). Reads `.opensearch-alerting-alert-history-*` via PPL `stats count() by monitor_name`.

tools.name: topology-map_view
tools.description: Load service map nodes and edges from the APM service-map index. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and optional `dataset` (default `otel-v2-apm-service-map` — discover via `list_index_patterns`). Returns nodes (services) sorted by call count and edges (caller → callee).

tools.name: topology-map_filter-fault
tools.description: Filter service-map destination nodes by fault rate bucket: `lt1` (<1%), `1to5` (1%–5%), `gt5` (>5%). Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `bucket`, and optional `dataset` (default `otel-v2-apm-service-map`).

tools.name: topology-map_filter-error
tools.description: Filter service-map destination nodes by error rate bucket: `lt1` (<1%), `1to5` (1%–5%), `gt5` (>5%). Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `bucket`, and optional `dataset` (default `otel-v2-apm-service-map`).

tools.name: topology-map_filter-environment
tools.description: Filter the service-map by `attributes.deployment.environment`. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `environment`, and optional `dataset` (default `otel-v2-apm-service-map`).

tools.name: topology-map_chip-filter
tools.description: Static reference panel documenting the topology-map filter-chip UX: example chips, how to remove them, and persistence behaviour. No data-source input.

tools.name: topology-map_node-detail
tools.description: Side-detail panel for one service node on the topology map. Aggregates the span index for that service into requests, errors, faults, and p50/p90/p99 latency. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*` — discover via `list_index_patterns`).

tools.name: topology-map_group-cards
tools.description: Group the service-map by an attribute (e.g. `attributes.deployment.environment`, `resource.team`) and render a card grid where each card shows the group label and service count. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `groupBy`, and optional `dataset` (default `otel-v2-apm-service-map`).

tools.name: topology-map_search
tools.description: Substring search on the service-map by service name. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`), `query` (substring, case-insensitive), and optional `dataset` (default `otel-v2-apm-service-map`). Returns matched services and the edges that touch them, plus their immediate neighbours.

tools.name: topology-map_drill
tools.description: Drill from a group attribute value into the set of services that belong to it. Pass `dataSourceId`, `groupAttribute` (e.g. `attributes.deployment.environment`), `groupValue`, and optional `dataset` (default `otel-v2-apm-service-map`). Returns the filtered subgraph as a node list and edge list.

tools.name: anomaly-detection_list
tools.description: List OpenSearch anomaly detectors. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`). Reads from `.opendistro-anomaly-detectors` via PPL.

tools.name: anomaly-detection_create
tools.description: Static reference: required + optional fields for creating an OpenSearch anomaly detector and the relevant `_plugins/_anomaly_detection/detectors` endpoints.

tools.name: anomaly-detection_mode
tools.description: Static reference comparing real-time and historical anomaly-detection modes with pros/cons and when to use each.

tools.name: anomaly-detection_grade-chart
tools.description: Plot anomaly grade and confidence over time for one detector. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `detectorId` (from `anomaly-detection_list`); optional `intervalMinutes`.

tools.name: anomaly-detection_feature-contribution
tools.description: Inspect feature-level contributions for one anomaly result. Pass `dataSourceId`, `detectorId`, and `anomalyId` (the result document `_id`).

tools.name: anomaly-detection_recipes
tools.description: Static reference: use-case → detector configuration recipes (latency / error / traffic / resource) with feature, aggregation, and interval suggestions.

tools.name: anomaly-detection_alert-on-anomaly
tools.description: Static reference: how to wire `where anomaly_grade > 0.5` into an OpenSearch monitor with an example monitor JSON.

tools.name: anomaly-detection_overlay
tools.description: Overlay anomaly grade with log volume from a logs index for visual correlation. Pass `dataSourceId`, `detectorId`, and `logsDataset` (logs index pattern title); optional `intervalMinutes` (default 5).

tools.name: anomaly-detection_historical
tools.description: Static reference for backtesting anomaly detectors via historical mode: detector config, run command, and how to score against known incidents.

tools.name: forecasting_list
tools.description: List OpenSearch forecasters. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`). Reads from `.opendistro-forecaster` via PPL.

tools.name: forecasting_create
tools.description: Static reference: forecaster config form fields (features, horizon, interval) with an example POST body.

tools.name: forecasting_predicted-values
tools.description: Plot forecast values with confidence-interval band for one forecaster. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `forecasterId` (from `forecasting_list`).

tools.name: forecasting_recipes
tools.description: Static catalog: use-case → forecaster recipe (capacity / storage / traffic / cost) with interval and horizon hints.

tools.name: forecasting_alert-on-cross
tools.description: Static reference: how to alert when a forecaster's predicted value crosses a configured threshold (capacity / SLO).

tools.name: trace-dashboard_top-services
tools.description: Rank services by latency, error rate, or throughput from a trace span index. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and optionally `dataset` (the span index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `metric` (`latency` (default) | `error` | `throughput`).

tools.name: trace-dashboard_top-groups
tools.description: Rank arbitrary group-by attributes (e.g. `resource.environment`, `attributes.app.version`, `serviceName`) by trace count and p99 latency. Pass `dataSourceId` and `groupBy`. Optional `dataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 20).

tools.name: spans_list
tools.description: Browse individual spans (not just trace roots) from a trace span index, sorted by duration. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`); optional `dataset` (the span index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), `status` (`error`|`ok`|`any`), `serviceName`, and `limit` (default 200).

tools.name: spans_exception-events
tools.description: List spans that contain an `exception` event. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`); optional `dataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), `serviceName`, and `limit` (default 100).

tools.name: spans_span-links
tools.description: List spans that have one or more `links` to other spans/traces. Pass `dataSourceId`. Optional `dataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), `traceId`, and `limit` (default 100). Falls back to `links != ""` if `array_length` is unsupported.

tools.name: apm-traces_list
tools.description: List recent root traces for a single service from a trace span index. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (the span index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`).

tools.name: apm-traces_error-types
tools.description: Group error spans (statusCode = 2) for a service by `error.type` and count occurrences. Pass `dataSourceId` and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (defaults `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 20).

tools.name: apm-traces_remote-callees
tools.description: List the remote callees of a service from its client-kind spans. Coalesces across `peer.service`, `server.address`, `net.peer.name`, `http.host`, `db.name`, `messaging.destination.name`, and `rpc.service`. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (the span index pattern, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 50). Falls back to a per-attribute merge if PPL `coalesce` isn't supported.

tools.name: apm-red_compute
tools.description: Compute RED metrics (rate, error ratio, p50/p95/p99 latency) bucketed over time for a single service from a trace span index. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (the span index pattern title — discover via `list_index_patterns`, defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `bucketSize` (`1m` | `5m` (default) | `1h`).

tools.name: apm-red_variant-picker
tools.description: Static reference enumerating the four metric variants — OTel SDK, Data Prepper, spanmetrics, GenAI — with the canonical metric name and label set for each. No inputs.

tools.name: apm-red_top-ops-by-fault
tools.description: Rank a service's operations by fault rate (statusCode = 2). Pass `dataSourceId` and `serviceName`; optional `dataset` (defaults `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 10).

tools.name: apm-red_bottom-availability
tools.description: List services with the worst availability (`availability = 1 - fault_rate`). Pass `dataSourceId`; optional `dataset` (defaults `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 10). Sorts ascending by availability so the worst service appears at the top.

tools.name: apm-red_genai-filters
tools.description: Static reference for the standard GenAI filter dimensions (`gen_ai.agent.name`, `gen_ai.system`, `gen_ai.request.model`) with sample PPL `where` clauses. No inputs.

tools.name: apm-red_genai-tokens
tools.description: Aggregate GenAI input / output token usage by model or agent. Pass `dataSourceId`; optional `dataset` (defaults `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), `groupBy` (`model` (default) | `agent`), and `limit` (default 10).

tools.name: metrics-browser_list
tools.description: List metric names on a Prometheus data source. Pass `dataSourceId` (a Prometheus data source id from `list_data_sources` — companion catalog tools like `list_index_patterns` cover OpenSearch index patterns; this tool targets Prometheus). NOTE: a Prometheus client is not yet wired in this build, so this returns an empty catalog and a notice.

tools.name: metrics-browser_label-filter
tools.description: Static reference for the four PromQL label matchers (`=`, `!=`, `=~`, `!~`) with examples and usage notes. No inputs.

tools.name: metrics-browser_group-toggle
tools.description: Static reference for how the metrics catalog can be grouped (prefix / A–Z / cardinality) and laid out (grid / rows). No inputs.

tools.name: metrics-browser_type-badges
tools.description: Static reference for the four Prometheus metric types (Counter / Gauge / Histogram / Summary) with definitions, valid PromQL operators, and one example each. No inputs.

tools.name: metrics-browser_drill
tools.description: Reference page for drilling into a single metric's label combinations. Optional `dataSourceId` and `metricName` are echoed into example URL + PromQL. NOTE: the Prometheus client is not wired in this build, so this returns a static reference instead of running a query.

tools.name: metrics-view_query
tools.description: Render a PromQL query against a Prometheus-attached data source. Pass `dataSourceId` (a Prometheus data source id from `list_data_sources` — use companion catalog tools like `list_index_patterns` to discover other surfaces) and the PromQL `query` string; optionally pass `dataset`. NOTE: PromQL execution is not wired in this build — the tool surfaces the query for review rather than running it.

tools.name: metrics-view_multi-query
tools.description: Reference card for rendering multiple PromQL expressions on one chart. Pass `dataSourceId` and `queries: string[]`. NOTE: PromQL execution is not wired in this build — the tool surfaces queries side-by-side and documents the binary / set operators (`or`, `and`, `unless`, arithmetic, comparison) used to compose them.

tools.name: metrics-view_latest-values
tools.description: List the latest value of each label-combination series for a metric. Pass `dataSourceId` and `metricName`; optional `dataset` (defaults to `prometheus.metrics`) and `limit` (defaults to 50). Falls back to `stats max(@timestamp), avg(value)` grouping when the index doesn't expose per-row labels — if the index doesn't exist, returns an empty list with the failed PPL surfaced for review.

tools.name: metrics-view_series-limit
tools.description: Static reference explaining why the metrics view caps series count by default and how to raise it. No inputs.

tools.name: metrics-view_time-filter
tools.description: Static reference for the time-filter widget's Quick / Commonly used / Custom / Auto-refresh presets. No inputs.

tools.name: metrics-view_add-to-dashboard
tools.description: Static reference describing the saved-object payload for promoting a metrics view to a dashboard. No inputs.

tools.name: metrics-view_exemplars
tools.description: Static reference for how a metric exemplar maps into the traces app, including the OSD URL pattern. No inputs.

tools.name: index-patterns-admin_list
tools.description: List index patterns scoped to a data source. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`); without it, returns an empty list with a hint.

tools.name: index-patterns-admin_field-mappings
tools.description: List the field name + type for an index pattern using PPL `describe`. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `indexPattern` (title — discover via `list_index_patterns`).

tools.name: index-patterns-admin_cat-indices
tools.description: List the raw cluster indices visible to a data source via `_cat/indices`. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`).

tools.name: index-patterns-admin_signal-badges
tools.description: List index patterns and tag each with its signal type (traces / logs / metrics / other) based on the title. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`).

tools.name: index-patterns-admin_create
tools.description: Reference panel: how to create an OSD index pattern. Documents the saved-object payload shape (`type: "index-pattern"`, `attributes: { title, timeFieldName }`), the OSD UI URL, and the REST endpoint, with example payloads for logs, traces, and metrics.

tools.name: agent-traces_list
tools.description: List recent GenAI agent traces (root spans where `attributes.gen_ai.system` is set). Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and optionally `dataset` (defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`).

tools.name: agent-traces_spans
tools.description: List individual GenAI spans across all agent traces (any span where `attributes.gen_ai.system` is set), sorted by recency. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`); optionally `dataset` (defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `limit` (default 200).

tools.name: agent-traces_metrics
tools.description: Aggregate KPI snapshot for the gen_ai-instrumented span set: Total Traces / Total Spans / Total Tokens / P50 / P99 duration. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`); optionally `dataset` (defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`) and `since` (ISO8601 lower bound).

tools.name: agent-traces_tree
tools.description: Tree view of one agent trace with `SpanCategoryBadge` colors per gen_ai operation. Pass `dataSourceId`, `dataset` (e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), and `traceId`; optionally `limit` (default 500).

tools.name: agent-traces_dag
tools.description: DAG view of one agent trace as nodes-and-edges. Supports CSS-transform zoom (0.1x–2x), fit-to-screen, minimap toggle, and ERR badges on errored nodes (statusCode=2). Pass `dataSourceId`, `dataset` (e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), and `traceId`; optionally `limit` (default 500).

tools.name: agent-traces_gantt
tools.description: Gantt timeline of one agent trace, with one row per span colored by gen_ai operation category. Pass `dataSourceId`, `dataset` (e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), and `traceId`; optionally `limit` (default 500).

tools.name: agent-traces_category-badge
tools.description: Static reference page documenting the SpanCategoryBadge color key (Agent / LLM / Content / Tool / Embeddings / Retrieval / Other) and the gen_ai.operation.name patterns that map to each.

tools.name: agent-traces_sync-selection
tools.description: Static reference: documents the `agent-traces:span-selected` CustomEvent bus contract used to keep span selection in sync across the Tree / DAG / Gantt views.

tools.name: agent-traces_lazy-load
tools.description: Static reference: documents the OnDemandChildLoader pattern for lazy-loading child spans in a large agent trace tree.

tools.name: agent-traces_tool-calls
tools.description: List all spans in a trace where `attributes.gen_ai.tool.name` is set, with one card per call showing name / call_id / arguments / result. Pass `dataSourceId`, `dataset` (e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), and `traceId`.

tools.name: agent-traces_exception-events
tools.description: List span events of name `exception` from agent spans, rendered as stacktrace cards. Pass `dataSourceId`, `dataset` (e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*`); optionally `traceId` to scope to one trace.

tools.name: agent-traces_attributes
tools.description: Inspect raw + formatted attributes for a single span (looked up by `spanId`). Pass `dataSourceId`, `dataset` (e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), and `spanId`.

tools.name: agent-traces_op-duration
tools.description: Compute P50 / P95 / P99 of `durationInNanos` grouped by `gen_ai.operation.name` (when `groupBy='operation'`) or `gen_ai.request.model` (when `groupBy='model'`). Pass `dataSourceId`, `dataset` (e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), and `groupBy`.

tools.name: agent-traces_conversation-groups
tools.description: Group agent traces by `attributes.gen_ai.conversation.id` and return per-conversation trace count, span count, total tokens, and first / last seen timestamps. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`); optional `dataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*` — discover via `list_index_patterns`) and `limit` (default 50).

tools.name: agent-traces_token-usage
tools.description: Sum input + output tokens per model (`attributes.gen_ai.request.model`) and render a stacked horizontal bar chart. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`); optional `dataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*` — discover via `list_index_patterns`) and `limit` (default 25).

tools.name: agent-live-tail_view
tools.description: Snapshot of the 20 most recent root spans. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and optionally `dataset` (defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`). Re-invoke this tool to refresh — there is no real streaming.

tools.name: agent-live-tail_agent-filter
tools.description: Snapshot of the 50 most recent spans where `attributes.gen_ai.agent.name` matches the given `agentName`. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `agentName`; optionally `dataset` (defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`). Re-invoke to refresh — there is no streaming.

tools.name: agent-live-tail_span-search
tools.description: Search the most recent spans by free-form text against `name` and `attributes.gen_ai.tool.name` via PPL `like(...)`. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`) and `query`; optionally `dataset` (defaults to `otel-v1-apm-span-*`). The query is sanitized — non-alphanumeric / non-`._-/ ` characters are stripped.

tools.name: agent-live-tail_maximize
tools.description: Static reference: documents how a trace or live-tail view requests full-screen display via the host's `requestDisplayMode` API.

tools.name: agent-live-tail_compare
tools.description: Side-by-side trace comparison. Pass `dataSourceId`, `dataset` (e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), `traceIdA`, and `traceIdB`; optionally `mode` (`aligned` | `merged`, default `aligned`) and `orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`, default `horizontal`).

tools.name: agent-doctor_report
tools.description: Static checklist of agent-stack health categories (Config / AWS Credentials / Agents / OpenSearch Storage / OpenSearch Observability). No live probing is performed.

tools.name: agent-doctor_init-project
tools.description: Static reference: walks through `agent-health init` and the minimum config needed before `agent-health doctor` and the evaluator can run.

tools.name: agent-doctor_migrate
tools.description: Static reference: documents the old (inline `stats`) vs new (per-trace `EvalScore`) shape and the `agent-health migrate-stats` CLI.

tools.name: eval-integration-recipes_list
tools.description: Static catalog of evaluator integrations (DeepEval / RAGAS / MLflow / pytest) with one-line descriptions.

tools.name: apm-config_wizard
tools.description: Reference panel: 5-step APM setup wizard. Covers traces dataset, services index pattern, RED metrics datasource, service map processor, and verification.

tools.name: apm-config_settings-modal
tools.description: Reference panel: the APM Settings modal. Documents the three settings it edits (Traces dataset, Services index pattern, RED Metrics datasource), their defaults, and where they are persisted (saved-object type `APM-Config`).

tools.name: telemetry-ingestion-config_reference
tools.description: Reference panel: example OTel Collector and Data Prepper pipeline YAMLs for ingesting traces and logs.

tools.name: telemetry-ingestion-config_otel-yaml
tools.description: Reference panel: example OpenTelemetry Collector config with receivers, processors, and exporters wired for traces / logs / metrics.

tools.name: telemetry-ingestion-config_data-prepper-yaml
tools.description: Reference panel: example Data Prepper pipelines for traces (with otel_apm_service_map) and logs, sinking to OpenSearch.

tools.name: telemetry-ingestion-config_service-map-processor
tools.description: Reference panel: configuration for the otel_apm_service_map processor (window_duration, group_by_attributes) used to derive service-map edges in Data Prepper.

tools.name: telemetry-ingestion-config_verification
tools.description: Reference panel: end-to-end ingestion verification — indices land, Prometheus targets healthy, and the APM UI shows data.

tools.name: telemetry-ingestion-config_index-names
tools.description: Reference table of canonical observability index patterns and what writes to them: traces (otel-v1-apm-span-*), service map (otel-v2-apm-service-map), logs (logs-otel-v1-*), and the Simple Schema variants.

tools.name: sizing-calculator_compute
tools.description: Compute trace storage estimates from traces-per-day, avg spans-per-trace, and avg span byte size. Returns daily span / RED metrics / service map volume and 30-day total.

tools.name: sizing-calculator_assumptions
tools.description: Reference panel: what each input to the sizing calculator means, the assumptions baked into the totals, and right-sizing tips for storage, retention, and sampling.

tools.name: mcp-server-config_reference
tools.description: Reference panel: how to enable the built-in OpenSearch MCP server, supported transports, and the tool catalog it exposes.

tools.name: mcp-server-config_enable
tools.description: Reference panel: how to enable OpenSearch's built-in MCP server in opensearch.yml, choose a transport (stdio / http), and notes on auth and TLS.

tools.name: mcp-server-config_categories
tools.description: Reference panel: tool categories exposed by the OpenSearch built-in MCP server (Index ops / PPL / SQL / Cluster info) and the canonical tools in each.

tools.name: mcp-server-config_examples
tools.description: Reference panel: use-case recipes for each MCP tool exposed by the OpenSearch built-in MCP server. Each row shows a natural-language prompt and the call shape an agent would make.

tools.name: stack-health_check
tools.description: Stack health summary. Returns the canonical port reference and component placeholders. If `dataSourceId` is supplied, also lists indices via `_cat/indices`.

tools.name: stack-health_service-logs
tools.description: Reference panel: docker-compose log-tail commands for each stack component (OpenSearch / OSD / OTel Collector / Data Prepper / Prometheus). Use to read what failed when a component is unhealthy.

tools.name: stack-health_runbook
tools.description: Reference panel: failure-mode runbook flyout for the four canonical stack failure modes (OS unreachable / no data / Data Prepper errors / OTel exporter failures), each with diagnosis steps.

tools.name: stack-health_doc-counts
tools.description: Confirm trace, service-map, and log documents are landing. Runs `source = <ds> | stats count()` against the three canonical index patterns in parallel and renders a KPI card per signal. Pass `dataSourceId` (from `list_data_sources`); optional `tracesDataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), `serviceMapDataset` (default `otel-v2-apm-service-map`), and `logsDataset` (default `logs-otel-v1-*`).

tools.name: stack-quickstart_tutorial
tools.description: Reference panel: 5-minute quickstart for sending your first trace and building your first dashboard.

tools.name: stack-quickstart_first-trace
tools.description: Reference panel: 5-minute walkthrough for sending your first OpenTelemetry trace via curl, verifying the span landed in OpenSearch, and opening it in Trace Analytics.

tools.name: stack-quickstart_first-dashboard
tools.description: Reference panel: 5-minute walkthrough for building your first dashboard with two panels (top services by span count, error spans over time).

tools.name: core-concepts_glossary
tools.description: Reference panel: stack architecture pipeline, glossary of observability terms, and common index patterns.

tools.name: core-concepts_architecture
tools.description: Reference panel: ASCII architecture diagram (Instrumentation → Collection → Processing → Storage → Visualization) with examples and a one-line description per stage.

tools.name: core-concepts_index-patterns
tools.description: Reference table of common observability index patterns: logs-*, otel-v1-apm-span-*, otel-v2-apm-service-map, .opensearch-alerting-*, and the Simple Schema variants.

tools.name: correlation-walkthrough_stepper
tools.description: Reference panel: numbered steps for one of three cross-signal investigations — metric-spike, error-log, or slow-agent. Pass `flow` to pick.

tools.name: correlation-walkthrough_evidence-board
tools.description: Reference panel: conventions for collecting alert / span / log evidence into a shared investigation board. There is no built-in evidence-board; the panel documents the saved-search, tagged-saved-object, and markdown-via-webhook patterns and shows three deep-link shapes (alert / span / log).

tools.name: correlation-walkthrough_service-pull
tools.description: Pull spans and (optionally) logs for one `serviceName` in parallel. Pass `dataSourceId`, `serviceName`, optional `spansDataset` (default `otel-v1-apm-span-*`), optional `logsDataset`, and optional `since` (ISO). Metrics aren't PPL-queryable; the panel surfaces a hint pointing to the metrics-view app for PromQL.

tools.name: panel-inspect_diagnose
tools.description: Reference panel: maps panel symptoms (no-results, syntax-error, timeout, wrong-data, slow) to likely causes and fixes.

tools.name: panel-inspect_inspect-flyout
tools.description: Reference panel: Inspect flyout tabs (Data / Request / Response) and the payload shape on each tab.

tools.name: dashboard-build_editor
tools.description: Reference panel: list of supported visualization types, bucket types, and value aggregations for dashboard panels.

tools.name: dashboard-build_create
tools.description: Reference panel: how to create a dashboard via the saved-objects API. Documents the payload shape (attributes, references, panelsJSON).

tools.name: dashboard-build_add-panel
tools.description: Reference panel: how to add a panel to a dashboard — `Create new` vs `Add existing` (from library), and the panel descriptor shape.

tools.name: dashboard-build_query-editor
tools.description: Reference panel: PPL vs PromQL panel queries with examples. Documents which language is used per data-source type.

tools.name: dashboard-build_axes-legend
tools.description: Reference panel: configurable axes, legend, threshold steps, and unit selection for time-series and metric panels.

tools.name: dashboard-build_bucket-config
tools.description: Reference panel: bucket Type / Interval / Bucket Size / Bucket Count / Min doc count / Order / Size semantics for grouped panels.

tools.name: dashboard-build_value-calc
tools.description: Reference panel: every supported value aggregation (Last/Last*/First/First*/Min/Max/Mean/Median/Variance/Count/Distinct count/Total) and what each computes.

tools.name: dashboard-build_value-mapping
tools.description: Reference panel: value mapping (raw → label + color) for metric / table / gauge panels. Documents match types and evaluation order.

tools.name: dashboard-build_variable-ref
tools.description: Reference panel: `$var` substitution rules in panel queries — formats (csv, singlequote, doublequote, json, regex) and adjacency syntax.

tools.name: dashboard-build_grid
tools.description: Reference panel: dashboard grid model (48-column snap, x/y/w/h/i fields, drag / resize / collision rules).

tools.name: dashboard-share_reference
tools.description: Reference panel: supported share / export formats for dashboards (URL, snapshot, PDF, PNG, CSV, JSON).

tools.name: dashboard-share_save-to-dashboard
tools.description: Reference panel: payload shape for promoting a saved visualization into a dashboard (panelsJSON append + reference).

tools.name: dashboard-share_share-menu
tools.description: Reference panel: URL vs Snapshot share modes for dashboards. Documents trade-offs and when to use each.

tools.name: dashboard-share_export-formats
tools.description: Reference panel: dashboard / panel export formats — PDF, PNG, CSV, JSON — with scope and rendering notes.

tools.name: dashboard-share_import-flow
tools.description: Reference panel: how to import a dashboard JSON via the saved-objects `_import` API, including conflict-resolution modes.

tools.name: variables_reference
tools.description: Reference panel: dashboard variable types (Query, Custom, Constant, Interval, Data source, Text box) with short descriptions.

tools.name: variables_query-variable
tools.description: Reference panel: Query variable form (data source / query / regex / refresh trigger / sort) for dashboard variables.

tools.name: variables_custom-variable
tools.description: Reference panel: Custom (static) variable form. Documents options syntax (`label : value`), max 100 entries, multi-select, and include-all.

tools.name: variables_variable-config
tools.description: Reference panel: shared variable configuration options — name, label, multi-select, include-all, sort, hide.

tools.name: variables_chained
tools.description: Reference panel: dependent (chained) variable wiring with a 3-step example (cluster → namespace → service).

tools.name: variables_preview
tools.description: Reference panel: behavior of the variable preview pane (live re-render, 25-row sample, regex highlight, manual refresh, error surfacing).

tools.name: transformations_reference
tools.description: Reference panel: post-query transform pipeline operations (Limit, Filter, FilterFields, Sort, AddField, GroupBy, ExtractFields, ConvertFieldType).

tools.name: transformations_pipeline
tools.description: Reference panel: full transform pipeline (Limit / Filter / FilterFields / Sort / AddField / GroupBy / ExtractFields / ConvertFieldType) plus toggle and reorder semantics.

tools.name: query-troubleshoot_diagnose
tools.description: Reference panel: diagnoses common PPL and PromQL query problems and links each symptom to a fix. Pass `kind` to filter to one language.

tools.name: query-troubleshoot_request-payload
tools.description: Reference panel: the raw HTTP request payloads to `/_plugins/_ppl` and `/_plugins/_query`, with example bodies for debugging. Static.

tools.name: _template_hello
tools.description: Trivial template route used to validate the MCP App framework contract. Returns a greeting.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List AWS OpenSearch domains visible to the configured AWS credentials in the current region. Returns each domain's endpoint hostname (use this as `dataSourceId` on query tools), name, region, and engine version. Replaces the legacy `list_data_sources` tool.

tools.name: list_data_sources
tools.description: Alias for `list_domains`. Lists AWS OpenSearch domains in the configured region.

tools.name: list_index_patterns
tools.description: List indices on a chosen OpenSearch domain. Use this to discover the `dataset` value to pass to query tools (e.g. `otel-v1-apm-span-*`, `logs-otel-v1-*`). Pass `dataSourceId` (a domain endpoint hostname) from `list_domains`.
